card.title: Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra No Signal fix

source.title: Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra No Signal fix

symptoms: very low or no signal after drop

claims.statement: Galaxy S22 Ultra losing signal after a drop—with baseband version present and SIM recognised—is usually the dock assembly or the GSM antenna cable and its top/bottom connectors, which can be cracked without looking broken.

procedure: Confirm baseband version present and SIM detected.
Try a known-good GSM antenna; replace doubtful connectors.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
